reviews.text:
Great. I used the app provided by my state dot (Iowa), paid their premium fee and studied like crazy, getting all correct many times on all the practices tests and covering all material, yet when I took the exam there were many many questions I was never presented in the prep.

This app however seemed to cover all of them, after trying this resource I passed on the next attempt. 
The feature to flag question that you need to review and present them on their own is a great feature. I failed twice before this app and nailed it after using this tool once…and aside from some ads, it was free.
My only complaint was a few questions that included fractions in the answers were presented in time and date formula which does not make sense. It was easy to provide feedback on those Ana I hope they get updated soon.
